html:
Da Nang, often referred to as Vietnam’s most livable city, is an ideal destination for the New Year’s Day holiday 2026 thanks to its harmonious blend of spectacular natural landscapes and modern architecture. From Ba Na Hills and the iconic Golden Bridge to My Khe Beach and the ancient town of Hoi An, visitors will enjoy unforgettable experiences enriched by distinctive local cuisine and vibrant cultural traditions.

During the New Year season, Da Nang becomes even more lively and enchanting as festive atmospheres fill the streets, beaches, and tourist attractions. If you are planning an early year getaway, explore the following highlights to make your New Year’s holiday in Da Nang truly memorable.

1. Ba Na Hills – A Fairyland Above The Clouds

Ba Na Hills is one of the most famous tourist complexes in Vietnam and a symbol of Da Nang tourism. Located about 25 kilometers west of the city center, Ba Na Hills sits atop Mount Chua at an altitude of 1,489 meters above sea level. One of its most unique features is the experience of four seasons in one day cool spring-like mornings, warm summer afternoons, gentle autumn evenings, and chilly winter nights.

Often described as a “miniature French village,” Ba Na Hills features European-style castles, spacious plazas, cobblestone streets, and romantic architecture. Every corner feels like a scene from a fairytale, making it a paradise for photography lovers. During the New Year holiday, the area is beautifully decorated and hosts various festive events, creating a vibrant and joyful atmosphere.

Visitors reach the summit by riding one of the world’s record-holding cable car systems. The ticket price ranges from approximately 800,000 to 900,000 VND per adult, including entrance and access to selected attractions at Fantasy Park. From the cable car, travelers can admire breathtaking views of the Truong Son Mountains, Da Nang city, and the stunning coastline.

2. Golden Bridge – An Iconic Architectural Masterpiece

Located within Ba Na Hills, the Golden Bridge has become one of Vietnam’s most recognizable landmarks. The pedestrian bridge stretches 148.6 meters long and is supported by two giant stone hands, creating the illusion of a golden ribbon floating above the clouds.

From the Golden Bridge, visitors can enjoy panoramic views of lush mountains, drifting clouds, and deep valleys below. It is one of the best places for unforgettable “check-in” photos in Da Nang. Although the bridge can be crowded during the New Year holiday, its spectacular design and surrounding scenery make it well worth the visit.

3. My Khe Beach – A Paradise Of White Sand And Blue Sea

My Khe Beach, recognized by Forbes as one of the most attractive beaches on the planet, is a must-visit destination in Da Nang. With its long stretch of fine white sand, crystal-clear water, and gentle waves, it is ideal for swimming, sunbathing, and relaxing by the sea.

The beach is free to access and well-equipped with tourist services. Visitors can enjoy activities such as swimming, surfing, parasailing, or simply walking along the shore at sunrise or sunset. Nearby seafood restaurants and beachfront cafés offer delicious local dishes and stunning ocean views. Even during the New Year holiday, Da Nang’s mild weather makes My Khe Beach an excellent place to unwind.

4. Son Tra Peninsula – The Green Lung Of Da Nang

Located about 10 kilometers from the city center, Son Tra Peninsula is often called the “green lung” of Da Nang. It features pristine forests, beautiful beaches, and a rich ecosystem.

Key attractions include Ban Co Peak with panoramic city views, Linh Ung Pagoda with the tallest Lady Buddha statue in Vietnam, and Mui Nghe one of the earliest sunrise spots in the city. Son Tra is also home to the rare red-shanked douc langur, considered the “queen” of the peninsula’s wildlife.

Visitors can also enjoy fresh seafood dishes such as squid, prawns, and shellfish prepared in traditional local styles.

5. Asia Park – A World-Class Entertainment Complex

Asia Park is one of the largest amusement parks in Southeast Asia, offering entertainment for visitors of all ages. The park is divided into three main zones: a cultural park representing ten Asian countries, an outdoor amusement area with thrilling rides, and a central entertainment zone.

The highlight is the Sun Wheel, one of the world’s tallest Ferris wheels, offering stunning nighttime views of Da Nang. Entrance tickets typically range from 100,000 to 150,000 VND, excluding individual rides.

6. Marble Mountains – A Spiritual And Mystical Landmark

The Marble Mountains, also known as Non Nuoc Mountains, consist of five limestone hills named after the five elements. Located about 7 kilometers from Da Nang city center, this site combines natural beauty with spiritual significance.

Thuy Son, the largest mountain, features impressive caves such as Huyen Khong Cave and Am Phu Cave, as well as ancient pagodas like Tam Thai and Linh Ung Pagoda. At the foot of the mountains lies the famous Non Nuoc Stone Carving Village, where visitors can purchase exquisite marble souvenirs.

7. Cu Lao Cham – A Peaceful Island Escape

Cu Lao Cham, a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve located about 15 kilometers from Hoi An, offers pristine beaches, rich marine life, and a tranquil atmosphere. Visitors can swim, snorkel, dive, camp overnight, or enjoy fresh seafood such as squid, sea urchin, and abalone.

Speedboats from Cua Dai Port reach the island in 20–30 minutes, with round-trip tickets costing approximately 300,000–400,000 VND.

Travel And Accommodation Tips For New Year’s Holiday

Da Nang International Airport offers convenient domestic and international connections. Within the city, taxis, ride-hailing services, and motorbike rentals are popular options. Accommodation ranges from luxury beachfront resorts to budget-friendly homestays. Due to high demand during the New Year holiday, booking in advance is strongly recommended.

With its stunning landscapes, rich cultural heritage, exciting entertainment, and world-famous cuisine, Da Nang promises an unforgettable New Year’s holiday experience. Whether you seek relaxation, adventure, or cultural discovery, this vibrant coastal city offers something for every traveler welcoming the New Year 2026.
